claims.head: The Predators get in close, the Bruins shoot from distance
claims.body: On shots from in close, Nashville is near the top of the league, but Boston is one of the worst. Shots from in close tend to be more dangerous, so expect the Predators to do more of their damage around the net.

claims.head: Where the Bruins have the edge: shot quality
claims.body: The Bruins are around the middle of the league for shot quality, and the Predators are one of the worst. It’s the widest gap between these two, though not a huge one.

Jayden Struble joined from MTL on Oct 10 and has played beside Adam Wilsby.
Matthew Wood has started killing penalties: on the ice for 26% of the team’s shorthanded time in 7 games, up from 0% last season.
Jonathan Aspirot has not dressed for the last 5 games. He is one of their more valuable skaters. Frédéric Brunet has taken his spot beside Mason Lohrei.

BOS.head: The Bruins have a slight edge
BOS.body: Boston has been out-chancing opponents lately and has home-ice advantage. Still, it’s close: the Predators can make it interesting if they keep dangerous shots away.

NSH.head: A slightly uphill night for the Predators
NSH.body: Boston has been out-chancing opponents lately and has home-ice advantage. The Predators can tip it if they keep dangerous shots away.
